annotation.notes: All 200 v2 pairs unchanged. Ten supplemental AI judgments; not independent expert ground truth or held-out evaluation.

supplement_provenance.method: AI-assisted assessment by Codex in this conversation
supplement_provenance.evidence_scope: Frozen titles and full primary abstracts only; no external sources or full texts.
supplement_provenance.item_order: SHA256(query_id:PMID) order; method names, ranks and scores omitted from annotation items.
supplement_provenance.blinding_limit: Prior conversation included method results and some p01 ranked titles/scores. This is not an independent blinded evaluation.
supplement_provenance.uncertainty_policy: Existing missing abstracts remain null. Medium-confidence new direct judgments are separately downgraded to partial in sensitivity analysis.
supplement_provenance.age_policy: Retain the base v2 convention for implicit adult scope; absence of age evidence is flagged, not presented as confirmed eligibility.

recall_scope: Known relevant judgments in the expanded pooled candidate set, not PubMed-wide recall.

missing_label_sensitivity.scope: Only the explicitly listed null judgments vary; unpooled candidate labels remain unknown.

conservative_supplement_sensitivity.policy: Only new medium-confidence grade-2 judgments become grade 1; all v2 judgments stay fixed.
